Bid Summary.value: Austin Independent School District requires a refresh of student and administrative laptops for high school campuses across the district under solicitation number AISD-2025-9988. The procurement scope requests 1,200 units of the Lenovo ThinkPad L15 Gen 5 laptop equipped with an Intel Core Ultra 7 processor, 16GB RAM, and 512GB SSD, alongside 1,200 units of the Lenovo USB-C Universal Dock. Additional requirements include Lenovo 3-Year Premier Support with Onsite Next Business Day (NBD) warranty coverage for all machines. Deliverables consist of the requested hardware, warranty certificates or affidavits, and proof of delivery with serial numbers.
